summary: Enroll in our Ethical Sourcing and Sustainability in Supply Chain Course. Equip yourself with the knowledge to drive sustainable change in your organization.
lede: Ethical sourcing applies environmental and social criteria to supplier selection, monitoring, and procurement decisions. This course is for procurement and supply chain professionals who need to assess vendor risks and turn sustainability goals into operational processes. It covers multi-tier risk mapping, Scope 3 emissions calculations, supplier codes of conduct, social audits, corrective action plans, and ESG reporting dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is specifically structured for professionals responsible for vendor selection, compliance monitoring, and supply chain strategy. It provides the technical frameworks required to embed sustainability into operational workflows.
modules: Social Compliance and Ethical Labor Practices
Circular Economy and Sustainable Sourcing Strategies
Digital Transformation in Supply Chain Transparency
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of general procurement, vendor management, or supply chain operations. Basic familiarity with spreadsheet software for data analysis exercises. No prior ESG reporting or advanced carbon accounting experience is required.
